_doc: Build-arch families (Q5). This is a COMPILE-TIME vocabulary, kept separate from the deploy/collection arch_id. A kernel fatbin may legitimately carry server slices (sm_90a Hopper, sm_120a/sm_120f Blackwell, sm_100a datacenter) that are NEVER valid deploy arch_ids. The DEC-2 deploy ban (supported_arches restricted to sm_86 + sm_120-laptop) governs the deploy axis only; build Makefiles are excluded from that guard by design. Seed values mirror arch_resolver.CC_TO_ARCH_FAMILY + common.mk gencode tokens.
_deploy_doc: deploy_arch_ids are the only tokens with a populated ArchProfile card and a place in the frozen label_admitted.json arch enum. build_only_tokens are compile/SASS-coverage slices (e.g. the Hopper wgmma kernels gated sm_90a); they must never appear in a supported_arches list or a label arch field.
